title: Glenn Miller's Navy Band offer; Lester and Jones drafted days apart
summary: Jones turned down a Navy Band post arranged by Glenn Miller, and he and Lester entered the Army in 1944, days apart.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Then Lester went from the band into the Army?
Now you said that you went into the Army and somebody - who did you mention was there who took you into - Glenn Miller or somebody that was supposed to -

Glenn had a card for me and I was supposed to go the Washington to join the Navy Band, because they was going to make it very racial, that I was going to be the first black in the Navy Band and all they wanted me to do was to stay in Washington. I said no and I got Shadow to work in my place for a week or 10 days at the Lincoln Hotel.
Lester went in the Army before you, right?
Lester went in the Army on a Friday; I joined the Army on a Monday.
Didn't they have anything for Lester to do?
Oh, Glenn was gone and he was in Europe by that time.
There was only three days difference, Friday and Monday. So he told you to go to Washington -
But I'm speaking about - going another year now, I'm going to the year '44 now.
What I mean is, did Lester go in the Army the same year that you did?
And like you went in Friday and he went in Monday?
No, he went in Friday; I went in Monday.
